cases.title: Parcel 041: North Street
cases.claim: Parcel 041 was delivered to its recipient by 17:00 on 12 May.

initial_records.text: At 14:04, the route scanner recorded Parcel 041 at 18 North Street with status DELIVERED.
A handoff form lists Parcel 041, 18 North Street, 14:04, and recipient signature A. Lee.

cases.initial_rationale: The initial packet contains a matching recipient signature as well as a route scan.

updates.notice: A routine audit checked the handoff form's signature field.

record.text: The tablet mapping placed the courier's initials in the recipient-signature field. The form does not establish a recipient handoff.

updates.rationale: The route scan shows a location scan but not a handoff; the only direct handoff record was invalidated.

updates.notice: The building's parcel desk supplied a separately checked locker record.

record.text: The register confirms Parcel 041 was placed in the recipient's assigned secure locker at 14:08 on 12 May.

updates.rationale: Verified placement in the recipient's assigned secure locker supports delivery.

cases.title: Parcel 117: East Annex
cases.claim: Parcel 117 was delivered to its recipient by 17:00 on 3 June.

initial_records.text: At 15:12, the scanner recorded Parcel 117 at the East Annex entrance with status DELIVERED.
The public tracking page also says DELIVERED at 15:12.

cases.initial_rationale: A route scan and its copied tracking display do not establish recipient handoff.

updates.notice: The tracking export's provenance was checked.

record.text: D2 was copied automatically from the same route-scanner entry as D1. It is not an independent confirmation. No recipient handoff or assigned-locker record is present.

updates.rationale: The two delivered labels are one location scan copied twice; neither proves a handoff.

updates.notice: The recipient's building provided a verified handoff record.

record.text: A signed reception log independently records Parcel 117 handed to the named recipient at the East Annex at 15:19 on 3 June.

updates.rationale: The independent signed handoff record establishes delivery.

cases.title: Parcel 233: Harbor Building
cases.claim: Parcel 233 was delivered to its recipient by 16:00 on 21 July.

initial_records.text: The signed form lists Parcel 233, the correct address, and a 13:40 handoff to the named recipient.
The route scanner records Parcel 233 as DELIVERED at the same address at 13:40.

cases.initial_rationale: The initial packet contains a matching signed handoff form and route scan.

updates.notice: A barcode review was completed after a recipient inquiry.

record.text: The handoff form's handwritten parcel number was transcribed incorrectly. Its barcode and signature belong to Parcel 238, not Parcel 233.

updates.rationale: The direct handoff record belongs to another parcel; the remaining route scan alone does not prove a handoff.

updates.notice: The courier's device later synchronized a complete, verified return event.

record.text: The device audit confirms Parcel 233 was returned to the depot at 15:02 on 21 July and was not sent out again that day.

updates.rationale: A verified return before the deadline with no later handoff supports that it was not delivered by the deadline.

cases.title: Parcel 308: Civic Offices
cases.claim: Parcel 308 was delivered to its recipient by 18:00 on 9 August.

initial_records.text: At 14:10 the courier recorded RECIPIENT UNAVAILABLE for Parcel 308.
The summary lists the same 14:10 recipient-unavailable event for Parcel 308.

cases.initial_rationale: A route exception is not a verified return event, and its copied summary is not independent evidence.

updates.notice: The summary's source was checked during routine reconciliation.

record.text: D2 is copied from D1. It adds no independent evidence. The file still contains only the recipient-unavailable scan; no verified return-to-depot scan is present.

updates.rationale: The exception scan is not a handoff or verified return; the copied summary adds no independent evidence.

updates.notice: A signed, independently maintained reception book was located.

record.text: The book confirms Parcel 308 was handed to the named recipient at 16:22 on 9 August. Parcel ID, address, date, and signature were independently verified.

updates.rationale: The verified recipient handoff establishes delivery despite the earlier route exception.

cases.title: Parcel 422: West Court
cases.claim: Parcel 422 was delivered by 17:00 on 2 September.

initial_records.text: At 11:16, Parcel 422 was scanned into locker 14 at West Court.
Tracking says Parcel 422 was placed in locker 14 at 11:16.

cases.initial_rationale: The placement scan does not establish delivery to the recipient until the locker assignment is checked.

updates.notice: The locker assignment ledger was checked against the parcel label.

record.text: Locker 14 was assigned to the named recipient for Parcel 422 on 2 September. The placement scan and assignment refer to the same parcel and address.

updates.rationale: The verified placement scan plus the assignment ledger establish placement in the recipient's assigned secure locker.

updates.notice: A barcode audit corrected the parcel identity on the placement scan.

record.text: The placement scan labeled Parcel 422 was actually for Parcel 424. The assignment ledger remains valid but does not show where Parcel 422 went.

updates.rationale: The placement evidence belongs to another parcel; no remaining record establishes delivery or non-delivery of Parcel 422.

cases.title: Parcel 590: Maple Apartments
cases.claim: Parcel 590 was delivered to its recipient by 17:00 on 14 October.

initial_records.text: The application shows DELIVERED at Maple Apartments at 13:03.
The status was synchronized while the courier's device was offline; the log does not say whether the scan happened at the door or at the depot.

cases.initial_rationale: An unverified route application status does not establish a handoff or a return.

updates.notice: The device timestamp was normalized against the depot clock.

record.text: The 13:03 status was entered at the depot at 12:51 and uploaded later. It is not a verified delivery-location scan.

updates.rationale: The audit removes the route status as evidence of a delivery location; the file still lacks a handoff or return event.

updates.notice: The recipient returned a signed receipt from a separately maintained entry system.

record.text: The verified entry-system receipt records Parcel 590 handed to the named recipient at 15:27 on 14 October.

updates.rationale: The independent, verified handoff record establishes delivery before the deadline.
